semiconductor_relevance: High — The Ministry of the Environment is involved in the production of compound semiconductor substrates and provides related manufacturing services and consulting.
summary: The Ministry of the Environment focuses on producing compound semiconductor substrates such as GaAs on Silicon, GaN, InP, and SiGe. They also offer manufacturing services and consulting, with a strong emphasis on environmental health and safety concerning hazardous materials in semiconductor manufacturing.
capabilities: Production of GaAs on Silicon substrates
Consulting on environmental health and safety
Handling of hazardous materials in semiconductor processes
technical_expertise: Environmental health and safety in semiconductor manufacturing
